content: Djenu bisine, kebenanu
Djenu bisine, wulwanu mbembu ami. Rodulanu ulile na tatanu! Dibandu maghughe amoduruyile.
Busine bwenu bumabungene. Bikutu byenu bisyeghe na batsyelili.
Mbongu tsyenu na mamani menu ma kembu bimabase maali. Dufundusu na maali meni. Dunyuru dwenu dubungu, dunyenzu. Dutsiwukighe busine yoyine tuke mu temu tsyusite.
Dutsidyonge basatsi abatsisale mu manungi menu, dughabafute. Ulilebelili na mitatu myowu mimatole tena ombu Nzambi, Fumu mabadi.
Dutsibeghe monyu wu maboti mu butambe, dwivayi mambu ame dwirondi, dwidji burange, mba dwivongi nane bibulu abibungulu, bikeboku mu ulighu.
Dutsifundise batu abaghavaghe dibi, dutsibaboke wandi. Tumbe djowu baghaghaghene.
Banu na pughu na sambilanu
Baane ba tadji, banu na pughu tena durughulu du Fumu. Tasanu muvaritsi ekeli na pughu milunde ami fwaru mi bivaru byandi, tena byubure. Ekeli mamvule amateghe na mamvule ma usite ameroyisi milunde.
Djenu wandi banu na pughu, wangelenanu. Banu na yikanene mumbari yilumbu ayi Fumu etu oghabuyile yimabambene.
Baane ba tadji, duyafundesenaange mumba Nzambi akédukilise. Wulwanu, nzonzi amabambene, ake va mune ndaghu.
Baane ba tadji, mu dyambu di ditsoghe na pughu, bonganu yibaghunu yi babiyitsi abamavose mu dine di Fumu.

Twivosyanu yi badji mu maboti, mumbari bamawarile. Mu Sobe, dumaghulu tsyeni amawarile mu temu ditsoghe. Djenu wandi, dwidjabi kabusulu adji Fumu Nzambi amamuveghe va disukusulu. Ngenze, Fumu Nzambi ane yingebe yi batu na ebavayi maboti.

Baane ba tadji, viri-viri pa dwivosi dyambu, duyaleve pesi. Duyaleva Nzambi, duyaleva butambe, duyaleva pesi mu dyambu dyotsu. Pa dyambu didji ngenze, vosanu: «yine». Pa dyufure, vose yi «nesi». Vosanu nane mumbari bunzonzi bu Nzambi bukédughaange.
Pa mutu va ghari enu etsoyi, asambili Nzambi. Pa mutu va ghari enu ane nzangu, awimbili noyitsi Fumu.
Pa mutu va ghari enu ane ubele, anengili bivunde bi dibundu, bakemusinge matsi na usambile mu dine di Fumu.
Dusambu nane dune dwivaghu na yitu, dubeluse yibedu mba Fumu omurelighe. Pa amavaghe mabi momutandu.
Kaboghu tandesenanu mabi menu na sambilanu mu bambatsi, mumbari Nzambi akedubeluse. Dusambu du mutu odjivu asungeme va wusu Nzambi dune mangolu maneni.
Tasetyanu Eli amabe mutu nane djetu. Amasambile Nzambi na yikanene mumba mvule djikémwénoghe. Ubandile va temu adjine mu bilime biryeru na yibuku, mvule djisamanoghe mu yinange yeni.
Va djulu vane, Eli amamwésambile mba mvule djikenoghe, na bivaru bikemwébende.
Ughabuse abatsyemughe
Baane ba tadji, pa mutu va ghari enu amasile nzile Nzambi vale, mba wumosi emughabusi mu nzile eni,
djabanu yiri, mutu oyighabusi muvayitsi mabi mu nzile, emughobuli o dufu. Nesi mabi mandi mabe pwele, Nzambi omutande moni.
